context: M21 o3 (wire branch). Lisle's building lobby. Marjorie Kell, coat on, keys in hand.

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: Mr. Arce. Miss Calloway said you'd come. Nobody asks the typist. She asked.

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: Office key. Cabinet key. Put everything back exactly. He measures the gaps.

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: And take these. My carbons. Fifteen years. In a laundry bag. Don't ask why laundry.

lines.speaker: char.marjorie_kell
lines.text: He never set up my pension. People forget the people who type.
